description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Blake Corum rushed 17 times for 93 yards and one touchdown while also catching his only target for eight yards in the Rams' 35-21 Week 7 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
items.impact: Corum has had a nose for the end zone of late, recording one touchdown in each of his last three contests. The dynamic running back remains an impactful option behind No. 1 running back Kyren Williams for head coach Sean McVay, with a Week 8 matchup against the winless Los Angeles Chargers up next.
items.title: Blake Corum reaches end zone in Week 7 win over Raiders

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Colby Parkinson caught five of his six targets for 48 yards in the Rams' 35-21 win over the Las Vegas Raiders in Week 7.
items.impact: Parkinson made the most of increased usage in the Los Angeles passing attack, recording over 40 receiving yards for the first time in his six contests. The tight end remains another risky option in a Los Angeles passing attack led by superstar wideout Puka Nacua ahead of a Week 8 contest against the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.title: Colby Parkinson sees six targets in Week 7 win

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Tyler Higbee caught two of his three targets for 14 yards in the Rams' 35-21 win over the Las Vegas Raiders in Week 7.
items.impact: Higbee has cooled off of late, finishing with less than 25 receiving yards in each of the last two contests. The tight end remains one of the more stable pass-catching options as part of a banged-up Rams offense, with a Week 8 contest against the Los Angeles Chargers up next.
items.title: Tyler Higbee quiet in Week 7 win

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Konata Mumpfield caught one of his two targets for 15 yards in the Rams' 35-21 win over the Las Vegas Raiders in Week 7.
items.impact: Mumpfield has struggled to make an impact in the Los Angeles passing attack, finishing with under 20 receiving yards in seven of eight contests. The wideout cannot be trusted as a reliable pass-catching option in any format ahead of a Week 8 contest against the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.title: Konata Mumpfield quiet in Week 7

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Davis Allen caught four of his five targets for 20 yards and two touchdowns in the Rams' 35-21 win over the Las Vegas Raiders in Week 7.
items.impact: Allen took advantage of an increased workload, finishing with more than three targets for the first time this season in the win. The tight end remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 8 contest against the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.title: Davis Allen catches two touchdowns in Week 7

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: The Rams D/ST recorded two sacks while failing to force any turnovers in a 35-21 win over the Las Vegas Raiders in Week 7.
items.impact: The defense was able to make stops when it counted, holding the Raiders to less than 50 rushing yards in the win. The unit will look to take advantage of an underperforming Los Angeles Chargers offense in Week 8.
items.title: Rams D/ST stands tall in Week 7

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Brandon McManus converted each of his five extra point attempts in the Rams' 35-21 win over the Las Vegas Raiders in Week 7.
items.impact: McManus offered head coach Sean McVay a reliable kicking option for the first time this season and will look for another impactful performance in a Week 8 contest against the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.title: Brandon McManus perfect in Week 7

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: The Jets D/ST allowed 208 passing yards, 156 rushing yards, and 28 points in a Week 7 loss to Miami.
items.impact: The Jets' defense tallied two sacks but failed to force a turnover. The defense was unable to stop Malik Willis and Ollie Gordon in either phase of the game. The Dolphins will take on the Raiders in Week 8.
items.title: Jets D/ST struggles in Week 7 loss

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Jason Sanders connected on 1-of-2 field goals and 2-of-2 extra points in a 28-25 loss to Miami.
items.impact: Sanders missed a 40-yard field goal to open the third quarter, marking his first miss of the season. Sanders will look to bounce back against the Raiders in Week 8.
items.title: Jason Sanders misses a field goal in Week 7

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Mason Taylor caught 5-of-6 targets for 62 yards and two touchdowns in a 28-25 loss to the Dolphins.
items.impact: Taylor has seen six targets in back-to-back games for the Jets and accounted for two of the team's three touchdowns Sunday. Taylor appears to be more trusted than Kenyon Sadiq by Geno Smith, leaving Taylor as the better option heading into Week 8.
items.title: Mason Taylor hits pay dirt twice in Week 7 loss

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Kenyon Sadiq caught his lone target for six yards in a 28-25 loss to the Dolphins.
items.impact: Sadiq has struggled to get involved over the past few weeks. He saw Mason Taylor score twice for the Jets Sunday, leaving Sadiq as a risky option heading into Week 8.
items.title: Kenyon Sadiq held to one reception in Week 7

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Adonai Mitchell did not record a reception on three targets in a 28-25 loss to the Dolphins.
items.impact: Mitchell was held without a catch in his return from a finger injury. He was overshadowed by an excellent performance from Omar Cooper. Fantasy managers can leave Mitchell out of their lineups in Week 8.
items.title: Adonai Mitchell held without a reception in Week 7

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: George Kittle hauled in 8-of-10 targets for 88 yards in Sunday's 29-20 loss to the Falcons.
items.impact: With both Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel out, Kittle put up new season highs in receptions, targets, and receiving yards on Sunday. The veteran TE is averaging just under five grabs for more than 60 yards per game with five touchdowns through seven weeks. Kittle remains among the top fantasy assets at TE.
items.title: George Kittle leads 49ers in receiving Sunday

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Omar Cooper Jr. caught 5-of-5 targets for 115 yards and a touchdown in the Jets' 28-25 loss to Miami.
items.impact: Cooper has put together back-to-back 100 yard performances for the Jets. He did the bulk of his work on receptions of 52 and 60-yards. Fantasy managers should view him as a strong option heading into a Week 8 matchup with the Raiders.
items.title: Omar Cooper Jr. finds the end zone in Week 7 loss

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Garrett Wilson caught 2-of-3 targets for 26 yards in a 28-25 loss to the Dolphins.
items.impact: Wilson turned in his worst performance of the season Sunday, with the star receiver not seeing a target until the second half. Wilson will look to bounce back against Las Vegas in Week 8.
items.title: Garrett Wilson quiet in Week 7 loss

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Kyle Juszczyk caught all three of his targets for 11 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 29-20 loss to the Falcons.
items.impact: With the 49ers WR corps beat up, Juszczyk was targeted a season-high three times on Sunday and caught his second touchdown of the campaign. Juszczyk has long been a valuable contributor for the 49ers, but he simply doesn't carry much fantasy value.
items.title: Kyle Juszczyk catches TD pass in Week 7 loss

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Isaiah Davis rushed for five yards on one carry in the Jets' 28-25 loss to Miami. He caught 3-of-3 targets for 49 yards.
items.impact: Davis was not really involved in the offense Sunday, with Braelon Allen seeing the bulk of the work out of the Jets' backfield. Davis can stay off the fantasy radar heading into Week 8.
items.title: Isaiah Davis sees four touches in Week 7

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Braelon Allen rushed for 104 yards on 17 carries in a 28-25 loss to the Dolphins. He caught 6-of-7 targets for 30 yards.
items.impact: Allen was heavily involved in both phases of the offense, with his seven targets and six receptions leading the pass catchers for the Jets. Allen has potentially carved out a role for himself even if Breece Hall is able to return to the field in Week 8.
items.title: Braelon Allen eclipses 100 rushing yards in Week 7 loss

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Jordan Watkins caught 3-of-6 targets for 56 yards in Sunday's 29-20 loss to the Falcons.
items.impact: With both Deebo Samuel and Mike Evans sidelined, Jordan Watkins led the way for 49ers'wide receivers on Sunday. The second-year pro is not likely to make much of a fantasy impact after the Week 8 bye.
items.title: Jordan Watkins eclipses 50 yards receiving Sunday

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Geno Smith completed 23-of-30 passes for 287 yards, three touchdowns, and one interception in a 28-25 loss to Miami.
items.impact: Smith and the Jets trailed the Dolphins, allowing for a high volume passing attack in the final three quarters. Smith connected with Mason Taylor twice and Omar Cooper for his three touchdown passes. Smith and the Jets will take on the Raiders in Week 8.
items.title: Geno Smith tosses three touchdowns in Week 7 loss

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Christian McCaffrey rushed for 39 yards and a touchdown on seven carries, adding six receptions for 61 yards in Sunday's 29-20 loss to the Falcons.
items.impact: McCaffrey dealt with a thigh injury for a portion of Sunday's game, but he still ended up gaining 100 yards of offense on 13 touches. He also found the end zone on the ground for the eighth time this season. He remains a top-shelf fantasy option.
items.title: Christian McCaffrey gains 100 yards, scores in Week 7 loss

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: The Dolphins D/ST allowed 25 points, 287 passing yards, and 108 rushing yards in a 28-25 win over the Jets.
items.impact: The Dolphins' defense tallied two sacks and one interception on their way to their first win of the season. The Dolphins' defense will face a tougher test in Week 8 against Drake Maye and the Patriots.
items.title: Dolphins D/ST allows 25 points in Week 7 win

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Zane Gonzalez connected on 4-of-4 extra point attempts in a 28-25 win over the Jets.
items.impact: Gonzalez was elevated from the Dolphins' practice squad and performed well in his first game of the season. The Dolphins will likely elevate him again in Week 8 to kick against New England.
items.title: Zane Gonzalez perfect in Week 7 win

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Greg Dulcich caught 5-of-5 targets for 86 yards in the Dolphins' 28-25 win over the Jets.
items.impact: Dulcich led the team in receptions, targets, and receiving yards Sunday. The veteran tight end should remain a key component in the Dolphins' offense in Week 8 against New England.
items.title: Greg Dulcich hauls in five passes in Week 7 win

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Kaelon Black rushed for 63 yards and a touchdown on 12 carries in Sunday's 29-20 loss to the Falcons.
items.impact: Black led the 49ers in carries Sunday afternoon and gashed the Falcons' defense for a 30-yard TD run in the second quarter. Christian McCaffrey did deal with a thigh issue in this one and ended up only outtouching Black 13-to-12. This was a nice game for Black, but he remains useful to fantasy managers only as a handcuff to McCaffrey.
items.title: Kaelon Black finds the end zone in Week 7 loss
